paragraphs: Shmuel the Elder, the father-in-law of Rav Shmuel bar Ammi: Sotah 10b. It appears from this that they were not careful to avoid a father-in-law and son-in-law having the same name, something against which R' Yehudah he-Hasid warned in his testament. Shmuel the Elder, before R' Aha: Jerusalem Sanhedrin, Kohen Gadol, halakhah 3; Ahad Dinei Mamonot, halakhah 8; and the beginning of Hayu Bodekin.
